title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How YF Digital Studio collects, uses, and protects your information
disclaimer: This page describes our current data practices in plain language for transparency. It is provided for informational purposes and is not a substitute for formal legal advice.
intro: YF Digital Studio ("we", "us", "our") operates this website. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and the choices available to you. By using our site, you agree to the practices described here.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.body:
Contact form: when you submit our contact form, we collect your name, email address, project type, budget range, and the message you provide, so we can respond to your inquiry.

Client and employee accounts: accounts on this platform are created by our team rather than through public self-registration. Account holders' name, email, phone number, and company details are stored to provide access to their portal.

Technical information: like most websites, our server may log basic technical details (such as IP address and browser type) for security and troubleshooting purposes.

Language preference: we store your selected display language (Arabic or English) in your browser's local storage so we can remember your preference on your next visit.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: We use a single, essential cookie to keep you securely signed in once you have an account on our platform. We do not use cookies for advertising, and we do not currently use third-party analytics or tracking scripts on this site.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to respond to inquiries submitted through our contact form, to provide account holders with access to their client or employee portal, to maintain the security and proper functioning of our systems, and to improve our website and services over time. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.heading: Sharing Your Information
sections.body: We do not share your information with third parties for their own marketing purposes. We may share information with service providers who help us operate this website, such as hosting and database providers, solely to the extent necessary to provide our services.

sections.heading: Data Security
sections.body: We take reasonable technical measures to protect your information, including encrypted password storage and secure authentication practices. That said, no method of transmission or storage is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.heading: Your Choices
sections.body: You may contact us at any time to ask what information we hold about you, to request a correction, or to request that we delete it, subject to any legitimate business or legal reasons we may need to retain it.

sections.heading: Data Retention
sections.body: We retain your information for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this policy, or as needed to meet our legal and operational obligations.

sections.heading: Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are intended for businesses and professionals. We do not knowingly collect information from children.

sections.heading: Changes to This Policy
sections.body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Continued use of our site after changes are posted means you accept the updated policy.

sections.heading: Contact Us
sections.body: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how we handle your information, please reach out to us using the contact details on our Contact page.
